english.title: Fail to return expired licence / badge granted under section 8A(2) / (4) of the Metropolitan Public Carriage Act 1869
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person to whom a licence was granted in accordance with section 8A(2) or (4) of the Metropolitan Public Carriage Act 1869, without reasonable excuse, failed, within the period of 7 days beginning with the day after that on which it expired, to return the licence, your copy of the licence (if any) and your driver's badge to Transport for London
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8A(6) and (8) of the Metropolitan Public Carriage Act 1869.
